_doc: Pikes Peak International Raceway (the oval) through the Lake Murray chain (tools/ship_track.sh; ONE-CHAIN §4 row 10, Kevin 2026-11-01: 'get a complete track list and installed by morning'). The draft is the engine's own on the OSM raceway way 1134026181 (source.type from_track over source/osm_oval_fixes.json, smooth_window 0, route.reverse to the real counterclockwise: gps -> elev -> project -> mesh), banked -10 deg (the unmirrored frame's sign for a left-hander, profile.py) through T1-T2 and T3-T4, then the underlay drops data/track.obj into loop.blend as GEN_* collections (scripts/blender/underlay.py). Authoring happens in that blend (AUTH_*), the prep / exporter run from airoso's scripts/ac, the gates run on the BUILT kn5. The workshop lives OUTSIDE airoso. Rehearsed offline 2026-11-01 up to elev (3DEP is unreachable from the cloud box): gps -> 1,666 m, 556 points from 63 OSM nodes, close_gap 119 m = a straight's own last->first segment; with a zero-elevation stand-in the projection reverses the lap, rotates the ring 288 points, and vertex 0 lands 6.5 m from route.start_at on the front stretch heading SSE; road_ribbon on that line raises the OUTSIDE edge at 288 of 288 full-bank stations. source/ppir_oval.kml is a pre-re-source trace (near Denver, 39.69 N) and is not read.
_owed: First pass = the oval's draft through the chain, no authoring yet (no pit road, no infield road course, no SAFER walls / catch fence, no grandstands). Under V1 this track never went green: ledger 0018 / 0031, 'rough everywhere, mechanism not found' (engine v0.52.0: 1,649 m lap, severe 68 clustered at s 240 / 640 / 1020 / 1400, bumps 94.01/km against 75, kinks 235.9/km; profile despike and ribbon pleating both killed). What differs here, and what to read first: (1) the FRAME and the BANK: mirror_x false, cambers -10 (was +10 mirrored) — on the built deck the raised edge must be the outside (right) one in every turn, and the AI line must read counterclockwise in-game (negative signed area in AC (x, z): Lake Murray's clockwise race_cw reads positive, ledger 0060). (2) the RAMPS: the V1 clusters sit on the V1 arcs' four 50 m ramps (231-281, 616-666, 1007-1057, 1392-1442); this config adds road_profile.ribbon_cols 8 (Exotics' fix for exactly that twist) and moves the ramps to 215-265, 680-730, 960-1010, 1450-1500 — so read drive_test's severe steps by station against those four windows first. (3) the LINE (smooth_window 0, 3.7 m max off the polygon under V1) and (4) the PREP, the first new thing to try (ONE-CHAIN §4). Then bumps/km, kinks/km and replication against the V1 row, with the mesh group of each severe step (ledger 0031). No gate is loosened (L5, GATES-CHANGELOG): red means not installed, and the reports come back for diagnosis. Kept flat by decision: both straights (the front stretch's dogleg too) — no researched banking for them (L10).
